response.sql: SELECT AVG(length) AS average_running_time, AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) AS average_cost_to_rate_ratio FROM film WHERE length >= 112

assumptions.assumption: A film is long if its running time is at least 112 minutes.

alternatives.interpretation: A film is long only if it runs more than 112 minutes.
